title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 117 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 117 - Deduction of Tax from Dividends The chief officer (chief executive) of a company registered in Bangladesh or any other company, while paying any dividend to any shareholder, shall deduct tax from the said dividend in the case of a resident or non-resident Bangladeshi- (a) if the shareholder is a company, at the rate applicable to the company; (b) if the shareholder is a person other than a company, shall deduct tax at the rate of 10% (ten percent) if the person receiving such dividend is a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) holder or at the rate of 15% (fifteen percent) if the person receiving such dividend is not a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) holder: Provided that the provisions of this section shall not apply to the distribution of tax dividend by a company, if the said dividend has been exempted from tax under clause 32 of Part-1 of the Sixth Schedule.
